text:
kai: FYI  small keystore tidy + RBAC prune this morning caused a cascade: SAST jobs can't decrypt artifact bundles and DAST probes are failing with upstream 502s. lots of aborted scans across many PRs. pinging @oncall-sec.

sofia: i ran the cleanup at 08:20 and rotated the key at 08:05. i thought the scanner SA was still in the binding but the logs show decrypt denied. digging commands and audit.

ben: CI snippets: `KMS.Decrypt: PERMISSION_DENIED` and DAST shows `upstream connect error or disconnect`. sample:
```
[scan-runner] fetching artifact bundle...
[kms] Decrypt failed: rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = caller lacks permission to decrypt
[dynamic-scan] GET https://staging-app.internal -> 502 Bad Gateway
```

sec-bot: alert: scan-abort-rate jumped to 81% in 10m. auto-ticketing suppressed to avoid noise.

kai: immediate mitigation idea: (1) grant a short-lived conditional decrypt role to svc-scanner (15m), (2) open temporary allow for scanner egress to staging for 15m, (3) re-run failed matrices and ensure raw bundles are persisted before decrypt step, (4) tag generated issues with `sdlc:rbac-rotation` so we can filter.

sofia: drafting command now. will post audit id when created. planned gcloud: 
```
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood-inference/locations/global/keyRings/prod-kr/cryptoKeys/prod-llm-key \
  --member=serviceAccount:svc-scanner@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter \
  --condition='expression=request.time < timestamp("2026-04-01T08:40:00Z"),title=short_svc_scanner_decrypt'
```

sofia: audit entry (redacted): AUD-9001-XYZ created at 08:28 UTC. temporary binding applied. also opened egress allow to staging for 08:28-08:45.

ben: add this tiny step to the pipeline to guarantee artifacts are saved even if decrypt fails: 
```
- name: Preserve encrypted bundle
  run: |
    set -e
    gsutil cp bundle.enc gs://vuln-evidence/${{ github.run_id }}/bundle.enc || true
    gsutil cp scanner-logs.tgz gs://vuln-evidence/${{ github.run_id }}/scanner-logs.tgz || true
```

infra-bot: rollback job queued for key tidy at 08:35 UTC per `rollback-keystore-3411111222`. status: queued.

oncall-sec: muting scan noise and alert routes for 30m while you re-run matrices. will watch SLOs and escalation channels. :white_check_mark: 

kai: triage-bot: create ticket SEC-9002 "Scans aborted after RBAC prune and key rotation" and tag it [sdlc:rbac-rotation, priority-high] and attach audit id AUD-9001-XYZ.

sec-bot: created SEC-9002 assigned to @sofia. tags: [sdlc:rbac-rotation, priority-high].

ben: follow-ups captured: 
- sofia: paste full gcloud command + audit entry id into SEC-9002 and schedule removal of temp binding after re-runs (due 20m)
- kai: add preserve-step to scan templates and kick off re-runs (due now)
- oncall-sec: keep alerts muted and report re-run success so we can close SEC-9002 (due 1h)

sofia: root cause hypothesis: combined RBAC prune + key rotation removed scanner decrypt permission and we had no artifact-preserve step so evidence was lost on abort. i'll add a rotation checklist item: verify scanner SA in keyring IAM and smoke-run scan post-rotation. will draft a short postmortem and linkage to SEC-9002. :memo:
